info.title: Polpo API
info.description: REST API for Polpo — an AI agent that manages teams of AI coding agents. Manage tasks, missions, agents, playbooks, skills, notifications, and approvals. For conversational interaction, use the OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint.

bearerAuth.description: API key passed as a Bearer token. Configure via the apiKeys field in polpo.json or the POLPO_API_KEY environment variable.

post.description: Polpo's primary conversational interface. Send messages in OpenAI format, receive responses in OpenAI format. Polpo runs its full 37-tool agentic loop internally — you describe what you need, Polpo handles the rest. Supports streaming (SSE) and non-streaming modes.

role.description: Message role. System messages are appended as additional context (Polpo has its own system prompt).

content.description: Message content — plain string or array of content parts (text / image_url)

stream.description: If true, returns an SSE stream of OpenAI-format chunks. If false, returns a complete response.

model.description: Ignored. Polpo uses its configured orchestrator model (or the agent's model in agent-direct mode).

agent.description: Target a specific agent by name for direct conversation. Uses the agent's own model, system prompt, and coding tools instead of the orchestrator. Omit to talk to the orchestrator (default).

200.description: Chat completion response (non-streaming). When stream=true, returns text/event-stream with OpenAI-format chunks ending with data: [DONE].

400.description: Invalid request (missing messages or no project available)

schema.description: If `true`, returns a slim projection: drops `outcomes`, `result.stdout/stderr` (keeps `result.assessment`), `expectations`, `metrics`, `maxRetries`, and truncates `description` to 200 chars. Default `false` — full record for backwards compat with the SDK and web UI. Bandwidth-sensitive clients (mobile) should opt in.

Drops `allowedTools`, `allowedPaths`, `skills`, `mcpServers`, `systemPrompt`, `reasoning`, `browserProfile`, `emailAllowedDomains`, `suggestions`, and the bulky `identity.responsibilities/bio/personality/tone/timezone`. post.description: Save credentials to the encrypted vault store. Credentials are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never logged or persisted in chat history.

account.description: Logical mailbox account (groups SMTP+IMAP of the same mailbox). Optional — defaults to `service` for grouping purposes.

allowedAgents.description: Other agent names allowed to use this credential (shared). Owner is always implicit and never in this list. Empty/omitted = owner-private.

get.description: Returns metadata (service name, type, label, credential key names) without any secret values.

200.description: Vault entries metadata for the agent

sharedFrom.description: Set when this entry is inherited via shared credentials. Identifies the owner agent.

readOnly.description: True for inherited entries — UI should disable edit/delete.

patch.description: Partially update credential fields in an existing vault entry. Only the provided fields are merged — existing fields are preserved. Optionally update type and label.

account.description: Update logical mailbox account name. Pass empty string to clear.

allowedAgents.description: Replace the list of agents allowed to use this credential. Pass [] to revoke all shares (turn back into owner-private).

credentials.description: Credential fields to add or update (merged with existing)

get.description: Returns per-provider auth health: config key, env var, OAuth profiles (metadata only — tokens never exposed), cooldown/billing status.
